commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She can’t bear to hear him blamed, and she says this to her heart.

My heart, go to the man she calls cruel, tell him of the uproar over my wasting arms, and can you win some honour? If so, nothing could equal it. “Cruel” implies he isn’t, and the arms waste of themselves. Once he hears you he will come and all this will end, a good deed done in time, and you will have its whole reward.
